肉包子？

柳桂香望着李青山递过来的香喷喷肉包子，小脸上闪过一抹惊讶道：“青山，这包子挺贵的吧，要不还是你吃吧？”

说罢。

便将手中的包子朝着李青山塞了过来，心中则是泛起一抹甜意。

被人关心的感觉，总是好的。

但是肉包子太贵了，还是留给男人吃吧，青山现在还是在长身体的时候，还需要上山打猎，要是不吃些好的怎么能行？

“嫂子，我在集市上吃过了，这是特意给你和娘带回来的，赶紧吃，吃完了咱们好搬家！”

“还有油条！”

李青山让柳桂香坐在旁边板车上，强行塞给柳桂香道。

柳桂香摸着手中还有些温热的包子，心中也暖暖的，这辈子确实没尝过肉包子是什么味道，若是说不馋嘴，那是不可能的。

当即张口咬了上去。

“咕噜……！”

对面。

老李家的大房，二房和李老屯等人，全都一脸渴望贪婪的盯着柳桂香手中的肉包子，恨不得现在就直接将其抢过来了。

所有人埋怨的目光，都落在了李老屯身上。

要不是李老屯。

今天他们，也应该能够沾上荤腥的。

“嫂子，别光吃包子啊，噎得慌，来瓶黄桃罐头！”

李青山说罢，便将板车上一个玻璃罐打开，里面满满当当的全都是黄桃和甜水，朝着柳桂香递了过去道。

肉包子，油条，黄桃罐头？

那可是八毛钱一罐的黄桃罐头啊？

奢侈，实在是奢侈……！

这一刻。

老李家看向李青山和柳桂香的目光，都看直了，李青山甚至能够听到口水吞咽的声音。

“嫂子，尝一尝！”李青山端着黄桃罐头，朝着柳桂香柔软的红唇递了过去。

“啊……！”

“还有罐头？”

“这罐头可贵的很，青山，你还拿给娘吃吧！”

柳桂香也是一惊，脸上满是惊诧之色，自己这辈子好像还没尝过黄桃罐头是什么味道的，只是听到被人说起过。

真没想到，自己这辈子，还有能吃到黄桃罐头的这一天？

这一刻。

柳桂香望着眼前这个俊后生，心中不断涌现着甜蜜和幸福。

被人关心和在乎的感觉，真好！

“桂香，你嫁到我们家也几年了，这几年是我们家对不起你，也没让你过一天好日子，这罐头你吃是应该的。”

青山娘开口道。

“没事，还有呢！”

李青山说完，又从板车上拿了一瓶黄桃罐头打开，递给了一旁的娘道。

柳桂香见自己婆婆也有黄桃罐头，便安心下来。

双手抱着黄桃罐头的瓶子，首先尝了一口罐头里面的糖水，果香伴随着白砂糖的味道，瞬间在口腔中回荡，沁人心脾，这让第一次品尝到黄桃罐头的柳桂香眼前一亮。

好甜啊！

好吃。

“青山，好甜啊，你要不要也尝一尝？”

柳桂香望着手中的黄桃罐头，虽然心中有些不舍，但还是给李青山递了过去道。

平日里吃糠咽菜的柳桂香，哪里吃到过这种细粮啊！！

“嫂子，我吃过了！”李青山拒绝道。

重生前，这东西自己都吃腻了，还是留给柳桂香吧，日后自己打猎多赚些钱，想买多少就买多少。

“呜呜呜……！”

就在这时，隔壁大房媳妇却突然哭了起来，脸上满是埋怨的望着李大奎道：“你个没用的东西，你看看人家，又是吃肉包子，又是吃黄桃罐头，我跟了你这么多年，吃上啥了？”

“当初，你在床上怎么跟我保证的？”

“你个没用的玩意！”

李青山的大娘一边说着，一边便开始动手挠李大奎了。

“哎呦，你这个婆娘，干什么？翻了天不成？”李大奎脸上顿时被挠出几个红印子，气的伸手就去互殴。

“没用的玩意，你还看呢！"

"老大家的在家里至少能吃上一些好的，我呢？我平日里都过的什么苦日子，你比你大哥还没用，我挠死你……！"

就在这时。

老二的婆娘也开始伸手挠自家男人，一边挠还一边道：“青有，青余你们两个爷们给我一起上，挠死这个没用的。”

“我挠死你……！”

儿子注定是有些偏向娘的，特别是在打架这种事情上，但李二奎毕竟是自己老爹，也不敢去动手打，只能去拉架，拉住自己的老爹让老娘挠。

一时间。

老李家顿时乱了套，两家人开始打了起来。

“干什么，你们都干什么？”

Meat buns?

Liu Guixiang looked at the fragrant meat buns handed over by Li Qingshan, a flash of surprise flashed across her face and said: "Qingshan, these buns are quite expensive, how about you eat them?"

Say it.

Then he pushed the bun in his hand towards Li Qingshan, with a hint of sweetness in his heart.

It's always good to feel cared about.

But meat buns are too expensive, so they should be reserved for men. Qingshan is still growing and needs to go hunting in the mountains. How can he do it if he doesn't eat something good?

"Sister-in-law, I ate it at the market. I brought it here specially for you and my mother. Eat it quickly. After we finish it, we can move!"

“There are also fried dough sticks!”

Li Qingshan asked Liu Guixiang to sit on the cart next to him, and forced Liu Guixiang to say.

Liu Guixiang touched the warm buns in her hands, and felt warm in her heart. She had never tasted meat buns in her life. It was impossible to say she was not greedy.

He immediately opened his mouth and bit it.

"Gulu...!"

Opposite.

The eldest and second bedrooms of Lao Li's family, as well as Li Laotun and others, all stared at the meat buns in Liu Guixiang's hands with longing expressions on their faces, wishing they could snatch them right away.

Everyone's complaining eyes fell on Li Laotun.

If it weren't for Li Laotun.

They should also be able to get their hands on meat today.

"Sister-in-law, don't just eat steamed buns. You'll choke. Get a bottle of canned yellow peach!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he opened a glass jar on the trolley. It was full of yellow peaches and sweet water, and handed it to Liu Guixiang.

Meat buns, fried dough sticks, canned yellow peaches?

Is that canned yellow peach costing 80 cents a can?

Luxury, really luxury...!

This moment.

The old Li family looked straight at Li Qingshan and Liu Guixiang, and Li Qingshan could even hear the sound of swallowing saliva.

"Sister-in-law, have a taste!" Li Qingshan held the can of yellow peach and handed it towards Liu Guixiang's soft red lips.

"Ah...!"

"And cans?"

"This can is very valuable, Qingshan, give it to your mother!"

Liu Guixiang was also surprised, with a look of astonishment on her face. It seemed that she had never tasted the taste of canned yellow peach in her life, she had only heard it mentioned by others.

I never thought that I would be able to eat canned yellow peaches one day in my life?

This moment.

Liu Guixiang looked at the handsome young man in front of her, and her heart was filled with sweetness and happiness.

It feels so good to be cared about and cared about!

"Guixiang, it's been a few years since you married into our family. In the past few years, our family has been sorry for you and hasn't allowed you to live a good life. You deserve to eat this can."

Qingshan Niang said.

"It's okay, there's more!"

After Li Qingshan finished speaking, he took another bottle of canned yellow peach from the trolley, opened it, and handed it to his mother beside him.

Liu Guixiang felt relieved when she saw that her mother-in-law also had canned yellow peaches.

Holding the bottle of canned yellow peach with both hands, she first took a sip of the sugar water inside the can. The fruity aroma, accompanied by the taste of white sugar, instantly reverberated in her mouth and was refreshing. This made Liu Guixiang's eyes light up when she tasted canned yellow peach for the first time.

So sweet!

tasty.

"Qingshan, it's so sweet. Do you want to taste it too?"

Liu Guixiang looked at the canned yellow peach in her hand. Although she felt a little reluctant to part with it, she still handed it to Li Qingshan and said.

Liu Guixiang, who usually eats glutinous rice bran, has never eaten such fine grains before!!

"Sister-in-law, I've eaten it!" Li Qingshan refused.

Before rebirth, I was tired of eating this stuff, so I left it to Liu Guixiang. In the future, I would earn more money by hunting, and I could buy as much as I wanted.

"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu...!"

At this moment, the daughter-in-law of the eldest daughter-in-law next door suddenly started crying. She looked at Li Dakui with a complaining face and said, "You useless thing. Look at me. She is eating meat buns and canned yellow peaches. I have been with you for so many years. What have I eaten?"

"How did you promise me in bed in the first place?"

"You useless thing!"

As Li Qingshan's aunt spoke, she began to tickle Li Dakui.

"Hey, you bitch, what are you doing? Are you turning the world upside down?" Li Dakui's face was suddenly scratched with several red marks, and he reached out to hit each other in anger.

"You're still looking at this useless thing!"

"Boss, we can at least have some good food at home. What about me? What a miserable life I live. You are no better than your elder brother. I will scratch you to death...!"

Just then.

The second wife's mother-in-law also started to scratch her man, and while she was scratching him, she said, "Qingyou, Qingyu, you two men, please come together and scratch this useless guy to death."

"I'll scratch you to death...!"

The son is destined to be biased towards his mother, especially when it comes to fights, but Li Erkui is his father after all, and he does not dare to fight. He can only start a fight, hold his father and let his mother scratch him.

For a while.

Lao Li's family suddenly fell into chaos, and the two families began to fight.

"What are you doing? What are you doing?"
